profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer on Nordstrom Analytics Platform
profile.summary: Software Engineer, Snowboarder, DIY Enthusiast, Kentucky Native, Master of Data Science

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
CUSTOMER TEAM
• Responsible for creating object models that accurately capture a customer’s presence within Nordstrom.
• Developed full end-to-end platforms responsible for stitching transaction information together to create profiles
that are used internally by marketing and business analyst teams.
• Technologies used: Java, Python, SQL, Spark, Hadoop, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Kafka, Spring, Airflow, Git, CI/CD, IntelliJ, Hive, Trino, DBeaver, New Relic, Artifactory, Startburst, AWS

positions.title: Data Science Rotation
positions.description:
FRAUD TEAM
• Participated in 3-month rotation with Data Science team shortly after completing my Masters.
• Assisted the Fraud team with an in-depth analysis of data from a new graph-based source, and the incorporation
of this data into their existing Machine Learning model.
• Technologies used: Python, SQL, R, Spark, Hadoop, Pandas, Keras, Airflow, Git, Hive, Trino, DBeaver, Starburst

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Data Experience - Headwaters Team

• Assisted internal teams with conversion of existing Kafka streams to Kinesis and the migration of each source to a unified system for ease of access across all Comcast Data Experience users.
• Wrote extensive unit tests with at least 95% code coverage for platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Kafka Streams · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon Kinesis · Jenkins · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Information Technology / Web Communications
positions.description:
Tasked with the construction and management of a newly designed website (www.frankfortcountryclub.com) through Jonas Club Software. Along with this project, I am also responsible for writing weekly newsletters in HTML and keeping all other web-based communications up to date. 

I also was responsible for typical IT troubleshooting around the office, until I relocated to Denver. The club is allowing me to continue this position remotely while I get settled in Colorado.

Website: https://www.frankfortcountryclub.com/
positions.insights: Skills: Jonas Club Software · Adobe Photoshop · Photography

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Research in the reliability of software using automated requirements tracing. I was an assistant of Dr. Jane Hayes primarily using a tool developed by the department called TraceLab. 

The purpose of TraceLab is to encourage code reusability through it's drag-and-drop UI. My work consisted of writing components in C# and translating previous components written in Java to C#. In my time I was also responsible for preparing presentations with my partner and together we submitted a paper to be published.

positions.title: Grader for Theory of Logic and Computing
positions.description: Graded midterm exams, finals, and homework assignments for 65+ Theory of Logic and Computing (CS 375) students

positions.title: Web Security
positions.description: Responsible for keeping security requirements up to date on their Drupal website. I also managed their server hosted by cPanel.

positions.title: Software Developer / Database Manager
positions.description:
An iOS Application developed by myself and 2 former UK students in Swift. Poppin provides time and location based drink deals around Lexington, KY. 

I created Poppin's database Poppin in Google Cloud Firestore and the map functionality using MapKit.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior Design capstone project appointed by UK's Solar Car Team as an effort to provide a competitive edge in endurance races. The goal was to predict minute-by-minute hyper-local cloud coverage for up to 8 hours.

This project was primarily scripted in Python using Keras as a machine learning tool to analyze photos of the sky taken by a webcam. The tool also pulled information from the Dark Sky API and predicted cloud movement. 

My main contribution to the project was developing an algorithm that separated the blue tones from the "cloud" tones in an image to calculate the cloud-coverage percentile.

projects.title: PRISM
projects.description:
• Contributing engineer on a new graphs & event-streaming platform aimed to improve real-time identity resolution.
• This platform consumes Nordstrom transaction event streams, using payment, email, & identity nodes to create a sub-graph containing a customer’s profile. This technology has been used to assist with marketing use-cases & for
detecting fraud within Nordstrom.
• Technologies used: Java, Python, Gremlin, Spark, Airflow, Kafka, AWS Neptune, New Relic, Kubernetes, Docker, Git, CI/CD, Terraform

projects.title: Token Repair Lead
projects.description:
• Lead engineer credited for discovery of major discrepancies in the way tokenized values are created & used across Nordstrom. This misuse of tokens caused billions of events to be produced with values that inhibited proper data joining for our analytical users.
• Responsible for architecting the repair solution & socializing the matter across Nordstrom.
• Technologies used: SQL, Kafka, ORC to Avro Conversion, Fort Knox (Internal API), DBeaver, AWS Elasticache
